dialogues.speaker: Maintenance Log (III)
dialogues.text: "Log: This switch is too high up. A ladder would be helpful. Climbing up every time is quite the hassle."

dialogues.speaker: Maintenance Log (III)
dialogues.text: "Reply: Due to budget constraints, no ladders can be made available, only grappling hooks.\nApproval Suggestion: Your body is in abysmal shape. Do more climbing — it'll come in handy later."

dialogues.speaker: Maintenance Log (III)
dialogues.text: (The rest of the content seems to be nothing more than ordinary maintenance records...)
